# `wardriving` capability's raw-flash circular log (heltec/main/wardriving_log.c
# unchanged from esp32/main/ -- see that file's own header comment for the crash-safety

SubType: since NOR flash only erases a whole sector

# Name: # at a time and this log needs its own sector-eviction/checksum scheme (see
# docs/PROTOCOL.md's "Flash log eviction" note).
# This board's 8MB flash (vs. the C6's 4MB) gives real headroom: `factory` above is sized at
# 2MB (vs. the C6's 1.5MB-ish default-table factory partition that BL13 found already 96%
# full after the `gps` port) so future capability growth doesn't immediately retighten this
# board's own margin. `wardrive` is sized to exactly 700 x 4096-byte erase sectors
# bound exactly (see that file) so no sector is silently truncated/unusable -- deliberately
# not stretched further to consume the rest of this board's 8MB
# fixed-size boot-scan bookkeeping array in wardriving_log.c and raising it is a separate
# not-yet-needed change. At ~150-190 bytes/record on-flash (wardriving_record_format.h)
# 700 sectors holds tens of thousands of records -- the same "comfortably hours unattended"
# bar as the C6's own wardrive partition
# Total used: 0x10000 (bootloader/table gap) + 0x200000 (factory) + 0x6000+0x1000 (nvs/phy
# already inside that gap) + 0x2BC000 (wardrive) = 0x4CC000 (~4.8MB) out of 8MB
# ~3.2MB unallocated for future capability work (display/lora are explicitly out of scope
# for this pass -- see docs/PLAN.md Phase 4 step 6).
wardrive
